description: Golden values for the six-wall L-shaped room. Walls of thickness 100 mm on centrelines (0,0)-(8000,0)-(8000,3000)-(5000,3000)-(5000,5000)-(0,5000)-(0,0), one 900 mm door centred on the south wall. Values are exact for orthogonal mitres.

outerFootprintCorners.note: outer face of the south wall runs from (-50,-50) to (8050,-50); inner face from (50,50) to (7950,50)
